Acetanilide and phenacetin have generally been re- placed by safer analgesics. Propacetamol is hydrolysed to paracetamol in the plasma. Paracetamol has analgesic and antipyretic properties and weak anti-inflammatory activity. The mechanism of analgesic action remains to be fully elucidated, but may be due to inhibition of prostaglandin synthesis both centrally and peripherally. Paracetamol is used for the relief of mild to moderate pain and minor febrile conditions.
